issues.legal_issue: A named executor who was bequeathed a legacy manifests an intention to act as executor only through conduct that sufficiently demonstrates that intention, rather than merely participating in cremation ceremonies or helping co-legatees manage property.
material_facts: The will bequeathed a share of the property to a person who was also named as an executor.
The will directed the executors to perform the testator’s periodic Shradh ceremonies.
The named executor participated in the cremation ceremony and helped two co-legatees manage property, but there was no evidence that he performed the Shradh ceremonies.
The named executor died before the will was proved, and his heirs claimed the bequeathed share.
issues.conclusion: The conduct shown did not manifest an intention to act as executor under section 141, so the named executor did not become entitled to the legacy on that basis and his heirs could not claim it through him.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 141 of the Indian Succession Act, a legacy to a person named as executor is not taken unless that person proves the will or otherwise manifests an intention to act as executor. The section’s illustration treats ordering the funeral according to the will’s directions as manifestation. Here, the Court distinguished cremation ceremonies from periodic Shradh ceremonies and held that participation in the former and assistance with co-legatees’ property management did not establish performance of the testator’s specified direction. No earlier cases were relied upon.

rule.if: legacy_claim_by_named_executor and will_not_proved and will_required_executor_to_perform_periodic_memorial_rites and no_evidence_executor_performed_required_rites and (executor_participated_in_cremation or executor_helped_cobeneficiaries_manage_property)

predicates.legacy_claim_by_named_executor: A person named as executor was bequeathed a legacy, and the claim concerns entitlement to that legacy.
predicates.will_not_proved: The named executor died without proving the will.
predicates.will_required_executor_to_perform_period: The will directed its executors to perform periodic memorial ceremonies for the testator.
predicates.no_evidence_executor_performed_required_: There was no evidence that the named executor performed the periodic ceremonies directed by the will.
predicates.executor_participated_in_cremation: The named executor participated in the testator’s cremation ceremony.
predicates.executor_helped_cobeneficiaries_manage_p: The named executor helped other beneficiaries manage property covered by the will.
predicates.legacy_not_claimable: The named executor is not entitled to the legacy on the basis of the conduct shown.

issues.definition: When a legacy claimant relies on a named executor’s conduct, and the will was not proved, the required periodic rites were not shown to have been performed, and the conduct shown was cremation participation or assistance managing co-beneficiaries’ property, the legacy is not claimable on that basis.
